job:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a string and an integer, compresses alternating equal-character runs into move counts, and prints a reconstructed E/S string whose block lengths and order depend on the parity of the number of direction changes." job]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare local state: initialize ggg to 'E' ^ 'S', leave n uninitialized for scanf, set goodp to -1, movesp to 0, and cur to 'E'. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND Read an integer into n and a string into in_str using scanf("%d%s", &n, in_str). RESULT input_data]
            [COMMAND Set n = n * 2 - 2. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Set moves[0] = 0. RESULT moves]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, incrementing i by 1 each iteration, if in_str[i] is not equal to cur then set cur = cur ^ ggg, set moves[movesp + 1] = 1, and increment movesp; otherwise increment moves[movesp] and, if ((moves[0] is non-zero and i is odd) or (moves[0] is zero and i is even)), set goodp = movesp. RESULT loop_state]
            [COMMAND Set parity = movesp. RESULT parity]
            [COMMAND If moves[0] is not 0, increment parity. RESULT parity]
            [COMMAND When parity is even, compute En as the sum of moves[i] for even i from 0 to movesp inclusive. RESULT En]
            [COMMAND In the even-parity branch, if moves[0] == 0 then print 'E' En times followed by 'S' max(n - En, 0) times; otherwise print 'S' max(n - En, 0) times followed by 'E' En times. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND When parity is odd, compute e1 as the sum of moves[i] for even i from 0 to goodp - 1, s1 as the sum of moves[i] for odd i from 1 to goodp - 1, e2 as the sum of moves[i] for even i from 2 * ((goodp + 1) / 2) to movesp inclusive, and s2 as the sum of moves[i] for odd i from 2 * (goodp / 2) + 1 to movesp inclusive. RESULT odd_counts]
            [COMMAND In the odd-parity branch, if moves[0] == 0 then print 'E' (e1 + 1) times, 'S' (s1 + s2) times, and 'E' (e2 - 1) times when e2 >= 1; otherwise print 'S' (s1 + 1) times, 'E' (e1 + e2) times, and 'S' (s2 - 1) times when s2 >= 1. RESULT stdout]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
